notes.title: Lovebugz Switching to Free
notes.notes:
Lovebugz: An Anthro Insect Dating Sim is just a small visual novel game created by essentially just me. While I adore the characters I've created, the game lacks a certain level of quality that bigger studio games can accomplish. It feels wrong to charge 3 dollars for this small game, which is why I have decided to make the game free to play.
I was hoping to have this changed by today, but I didn't look into how this stuff works so the change will be happening later this month.
If you have purchased the game, I thank you for your support and want you to know that the money will be used to help with Chapter 2, which should be releasing this summer if things go well.

notes.title: I Made a Mistake
notes.notes: I made Lovebugz to have fun with bugs while also teaching about insects. I try my best to give each arthropod proper justice, but I messed up with the butterfly's original design. This update fixes that and gives Greta a new proper limb count. There's also more grass.

notes.title: Paper Scrap Update
notes.notes:
You can now read the scrap of paper in the library. Does it add lore? Probably. Is it important? Probably not.
Updated images for Lydia, Ortho Grylls, and the termites.
The garage door no longer slows down when you close it, allowing you to spam it for extra fun.
